messages:
Anna (oncall): Starting an RCA draft for last night's paging incident (INC-4321). Posting here so we can coordinate owners and signoff flow. High level: hosted inference latency spike -> 5xx for a subset of requests -> automated fallback didn't kick for ~18m for some customers.

Mike (runtime): I can take timeline + mitigation steps. I have the agg logs and the runtime traces.

Jess (CSM): I'll handle customer impact and reach out to affected accounts with a preliminary summary once we have the draft. Can we schedule a 30m postmortem review tomorrow? 10:00am PT works for me.

incident-bot: PAGED @oncall at 2026-02-14T03:17:42Z for alert: high_5xx_rate / hosted-api-prod. 4 pages sent, severity=sev2.

Anna (oncall): Quick notes from the live mitigation timeline while it's fresh: we rolled a config revert at 03:25 which reduced 5xx rate but some regions still saw errors until 03:43. Handoff from me -> Mike happened at 04:00 during escalation.

Sanjay (infra): What's the root cause candidate? I'm guessing something in the batching/kvs path after the config change. I saw a spike in KV cache misses correlating to the errors.

Mike (runtime): Agreed. In the traces I saw a surge of OOM-ish slowdowns on the LRU eviction path after the config push. Putting a short timeline here:

```
03:12 UTC - deploy (config: dynamic-batching tweak v2)
03:17 UTC - first automated alert: high 5xx
03:25 UTC - mitigation: revert config -> partial recovery
03:43 UTC - complete traffic drain from bad variant
04:00 UTC - oncall handoff to Mike
```

Jess (CSM): For customer impact I'll note: ~8 tenants experienced increased error rates; 3 had >5% error rate for 15+ minutes. Need to confirm exact API keys before outreach.

Leo (platform): For the postmortem action items, we should include: (1) revert safety guard (fail closed) for config pushes, (2) improve deploy-time canary rule for batching configs, (3) KV cache instrumentation to show eviction pressure.

Kate (PM): Please add a remediation ETA for each action item. Execs will want dates. Also include whether this requires Dedicated customers to be contacted separately.

Anna (oncall): Draft doc link: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4321-rca (placeholder). I'll start the doc skeleton with sections: Summary, Timeline, Contributing Factors, Impact, Mitigation, Action Items, Followups.

Mike (runtime): I'll drop logs for the critical window into the doc and write the mitigation subsection. Need Sanjay or Leo to sanity-check the KV hypothesis.

Sanjay (infra): I'll do the infra review. If it's KV eviction pressure we should include a load test to reproduce before pushing changes.

Jess (CSM): Scheduling: tomorrow 10:00am PT for the review. Please add calendar invite and set it to 'Incident RCA review - INC-4321'. I'll invite CS leadership + affected account owners.

incident-bot: Reminder: Postmortem draft due by 2026-02-16T23:59Z for internal review.

Anna (oncall): Action items (quick list) — I'll also create tickets:
- A1 (owner: Mike): Fill timeline + mitigation in doc; add raw traces. ETA: 2026-02-15 EOD.
- A2 (owner: Sanjay): Infra repro & KV instrumentation task. ETA: 2026-02-22.
- A3 (owner: Leo): Add deploy guard for config pushes + playbook. ETA: 2026-02-19.
- A4 (owner: Jess): Customer outreach draft & affected key list. ETA: 2026-02-15 morning.
- A5 (owner: Kate): Exec summary + signoff coord. ETA: 2026-02-17.

Mike (runtime): A1 acked. I'll mark PRs and paste diffs in the doc.

Leo (platform): Will prep the canary changes and a short rollout plan. Tagging @Sanjay for load test requirements.

Sanjay (infra): Ack A2. I'll create a test harness and a bug ticket for the KV path.

Jess (CSM): I'll draft outreach and coordinate with legal if we need an embargoed statement.

Anna (oncall): Peer review plan: Sanjay and Leo to review technical sections. Kate + Jess to review impact/communication. After technical review, I'll request final signoff from Eng leadership (Kate will coordinate). Target final signoff by 2026-02-19 COB.

Mike (runtime): One more note: during the incident the bot paged multiple times with the same alert; we should tune alert dedupe window so oncall isn't spammed. Add as A6 (owner: Anna) ETA: 2026-02-18.

Anna (oncall): Added A6. Also adding a short 'lessons learned' blurb: we need to treat dynamic-batching config as high-risk—require a two-step canary with traffic shaping.

Kate (PM): Thanks — please flag any customer-sensitive language. I'll confirm the exec recipients after the draft.

Anna (oncall): Ok team — I'll kick off the calendar invite and create the tickets. Once Sanjay/Leo review the technical writeup, drop a :eyes: reaction on the doc and reply here so we can move to signoff.

Mike (runtime): Dropping first pass now. ping when reviews are in.

Sanjay (infra): Reviewing now. Expect comments in the doc within 3 hours.

Jess (CSM): Thx. I'll prepare the outreach template and post it in the doc for review.

Leo (platform): Will review canary plan tomorrow morning and add rollout playbook.

Anna (oncall): Closing note: tagging this thread for visibility only — final signoff flow will be recorded in the RCA doc. If anyone needs to escalate the ETA for their action items, ping here.

Kate (PM): Got it. Thanks everyone.
